title: TransHarness: From Benchmark Overfitting to Transferable Harness Evolution
title_zh: TransHarness：从基准过拟合到可迁移的智能体运行框架演化
abstract_en: Harness evolution offers a path to improving coding agents without updating model weights. However, existing methods can overfit their evolution benchmarks, producing gains that fail to carry over to new tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Transferable Harness Evolution (TransHarness), which evolves harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts. These policies couple execution-context triggers with diagnostic guidance, enabling task-dependent checks and corrections beyond the source executions. Cross-task replay and independent semantic selection retain policies that intervene selectively and ground corrections in current-task evidence rather than source-specific solutions. We further curate an independent evolution set for cross-distribution transfer and conduct a cross-benchmark evaluation covering multiple strong models and a range of lightweight and mature harnesses. Experiments show that, with only 300 source trajectories from outside the test distribution, TransHarness further improves strong agents across distinct target benchmarks, demonstrating transferable harness evolution beyond benchmark overfitting. Specifically, TransHarness achieves state-of-the-art scores of 76.4% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 95.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, surpassing the strongest baseline model, GPT-6 Astra, by 2.4 and 5.6 percentage points, respectively.
abstract_zh: 演化运行框架（harness）可以在不更新模型权重的情况下提升编程智能体的表现，但现有方法容易过拟合用于演化的基准，导致收益难以迁移到新任务。为此，论文提出 Transferable Harness Evolution（TransHarness），通过对比同一任务上的成功与失败轨迹，提炼运行框架的干预策略。每条策略将执行上下文中的触发条件与诊断指引配对，使智能体能针对新任务执行检查与纠正。方法通过跨任务回放与独立语义筛选，保留能够按需介入、依据当前任务证据纠错的策略，而非复用源任务的具体解法。作者构建了独立的演化数据集，并在多个强模型、轻量及成熟运行框架上开展跨基准评估。仅使用来自测试分布之外的 300 条源轨迹，TransHarness 就能进一步提升强智能体在不同目标基准上的表现，在 DeepSWE v1.1 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上分别达到 76.4% 和 95.5%，均为最先进成绩，较最强基线 GPT-6 Astra 分别高出 2.4 和 5.6 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 对比同一任务的成功与失败轨迹，提炼由触发条件和诊断指引组成的干预策略。
通过跨任务回放和独立语义筛选，保留按需介入、依据当前任务证据纠错的策略，避免照搬源任务解法。
仅用 300 条来自测试分布之外的源轨迹进行演化，并在多个强模型及轻量、成熟运行框架上开展跨基准评估。
DeepSWE v1.1 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 分别达到 76.4% 和 95.5%，较 GPT-6 Astra 分别高出 2.4 和 5.6 个百分点。
